verdict.rationale: Metronome documents its own capability to import existing contracts and invoices for customers first provisioned outside Metronome, which covers part of migrating live billing relationships. Nothing in the evidence addresses spreadsheet or competitor-specific import tooling, card data transfer, or keeping the cutover invisible to customers. Missing for 10: spreadsheet/CSV bulk import, competitor-platform migration tooling, PCI-compliant card data transfer, evidence of a seamless customer-invisible cutover, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing

citations.quote: Metronome offers a unified source of truth for your customers' billing history, even if you initially provisioned them outside of Metronome. You can easily import existing contracts and invoices into Metronome.
